notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Finally the big patch is released.

Gameplay Changes

Now Hard Mode has 10 levels of difficulty ("Ascension Mode")
Now you can switch on/off Reinforcement (in Options)
“Save and Quit feature/bug/abuse” now does not work for the Fortune Teller;)

New Content
New creatures:

Sogg-Yaron (Boss). [spoiler]Phase 1: Phase. You cannot play more than 3 cards per turn. Phase 2: Phase. Whenever you play a card, discard 2 cards then draw a card. Phase 3: Ethereal. Endurance.[/spoiler]
Beholder. 2/12. Whenever you play a card, increase the attack of another random creature by 1.

New Item:

Eye of Sogg-Yaron. Unplayable. If this card is in your hand all your skill cards deal 3 more damage.

New Skill:

Pyromaniac (Arcanist). Choose One - Draw all “Fireball” cards from the draw and discard pile; Deal 1-3 damage to 2 random creatures.

New Keywords:

Prowler - If you have 3 or more Treasure cards in your deck, this creature's attack doubles.
Unplayable - You can't play this card from your hand.

Balance changes

Shadow Thief was reworked: Prowler. Whenever this creature attacks, exile a random Treasure card from the draw pile.
Mimic was reworked: 2/7. Prowler. Entomb: Delve an Item card twice.
Thing was reworked: 0/20 Slow. Each time you play a card, increase this creature attack by 1.
Queen of Thieves was reworked: [spoiler]Phase 1: Phase. Prowler. Whenever this creature attacks, summon 2 Shadow Thieves. Phase 2: Slow. At the start of your turn, you may exile a card from your hand and decrease Queen of Thieves attack by 3 or summon a Shadow Thief.[/spoiler]
Marauder was reworked: attack decreased from 4 -> 3 and health increased from 5 -> 6. Marauder now has a Prowler keyword.
Hag was buffed: attack increased.
Runesmith is a Heroic skill card now.
Master of Elements buff: damage increased from 2 -> 3.

UI

Add a card preview to card collection and library.
Card preview is incresed (Hand, Discard and Draw Pile, Level Up).

Bug Fix

Bug with Magic Sword and Absolute Zero.
Bug with Tarot Moon and Throwing Axe.
Bug with Beholder (when there were no targets for his ability).
Game freeze after defeating the Master.
Double attack on the Queen of Thieves (bug with Prowler).

Special thanks to:
Targus (translator) and Killpower (proofreader and webmaster of http://rpgjeuxvideo.com) for the French localization.
And all our players that report bugs.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33480917/b67b1c037faad992652a4bbdf22517e261336b42.png


Finally the big news – Fate Hunters is now officially and properly released. Hooray!
Special thanks to:
Targus (translator) and Killpower (proofreader and webmaster of http://rpgjeuxvideo.com) for the French localization.
Војислав Босиљчић for English proofreading
And all our players that report bugs and and actively participate in the development of our game!

But it’s not only about a title change – today the game has received an important update. Check out what’s new:

New Features
Card Library - you can see all the cards that are in the game

New Keyword
Permanent - Card can't be exiled.

New Content
Raider skill cards:

Ray of Destruction - Deal 1 damage to a creature for each 10 cards in your deck. If your deck has 50 or more cards, double damage from this card.
Soulthirst - Draw all Soul Stone from your draw and discard pile. If you have no Soul Stone in your deck, deal 2 damage to all creatures and you become possessed.
Souls Burst - Reserve. Can only be played if you have 3 or more Soul Stone in your deck. Deal 7 damage to a creature.
Devouring - Deal 3 damage to a creature. If your deck has 30 or more cards, double the number of Soul Stones in your draw pile
Shield of Darkness - Permanent. Gain a Shield. Exile the top card from the draw pile.
Corruption - Deal 3 damage to a creature. This turn, each time you exile a card deal 6 damage to a random creature.
Void Pact - Permanent. Restore 2 HP. This turn, cards can't be exiled from your draw pile.
Magic Chains - Permanent. This turn, if you become possessed, you draw a card instead. 
Bane - Deal 4-5 damage to a creature. If your deck has fewer than 25 cards you become possessed.
Offering - One Use. Exile the top card from your draw pile. If the exiled card is a Treasure increase your max HP by 2. Otherwise add a Raider Hand to your hand.
Devil's Trick - Draw a card, then put a card from your hand on the top of your draw pile. This turn, your next played card with One Use doesn't removed from your deck
Nightmare - Deal 1 damage to a creature. Exile a card from your draw pile, then increase this card's damage by 1 (max. 10 damage).
Cunning Plan - Draw 5 cards, then put 4 cards from your hand on top of the draw pile.
Slice - One Use. Deal 6 damage to a creature. If you become possessed this turn add a copy of this card to your discard pile.
Eviscerate - Reserve. Critical Strike. Deal 5 damage to a creature. You become possessed.


Heroic skill cards:

Demonic Form (for Raider) - One Use. Deal 3 damage to all creatures. Restore 3 HP. Exile all cards from your hand and replace them with Eviscerate. 


Item cards:

Whetstone (only for Berserker) - This turn, all your Weapon cards has a Critical Strike. Your next Weapon card is played twice.
Bloody Crown (only for Raider) - One Use. Increase your max HP by 3. Slightly increase chance to become possessed.
Soul Lantern - Treasure: 50. One Use. Increase your max HP by 1 for every non-summoned creatures killed this turn. 


Balance Changes:

Blood Drinker buff: max. damage increased from 5 -> 7.
Sword of Heroes buff: damage for each Heroic skill card increased from 2 -> 3.
Bane of the Meek re-work: Enchanted. Critical Strike. Reserve. Deal 1 damage to all creatures.
Dark Offer buff: add 3 Soul Stone instead 2.
Inferno buff: damage increased from 4 -> 5
Dark Flame buff: Now has Permanent.
Resurrection nerf: HP restore decreased from 8 -> 7.
Power cost reduced from 5 -> 3.
Tarot Chariot rework: When you deal 5 or more damage to one creature, stun a random non-boss creature. Activated only once per fight.
Tarot Lovers rework: Whenever you add a non-heroic skill card to your deck, add an extra copy. Reduce your max. HP by 2.
Tarot Moon added additional effect: Creatures cannot exile cards from your deck.
Tarot Empress added additional effect: If your hero dies, you only lose half of your gold (rounded up).
Tarot Strength rework: Damage from all weapon cards is increased by 2. Damage from all skill cards is decreased by 2 (damage can't be reduced below 1).
Heavy Axe nerf: Deal 2 damage to a creature. If your deck has (25 -> 30) or more cards, deal 5 damage instead.
Runic Ring nerf: Restore 2 HP. If your deck has (25 -> 30) or more cards, draw a card.
Vengeful Spirit buff: HP increased from 1 to 2. Now has Ethereal.
Shadow Council buff: HP increased from 20 -> 22.
Raider (boss) buff: HP increased from 60 -> 66.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #3 - Stamina Concept
notes.content:
The game has a problem with “infinity decks” that kill for 1 turn, any number of enemies
In most cases, “infinity decks” are obtained if you have a large number of cards in your deck that draw cards.
And we have the following idea how to solve this problem:
- A new parameter - Stamina
- Each character has 10 Stamina
- Each card that you draw per turn, takes 1 unit from Stamina
- If a player draw a card and he has 0 Stamina, then the Fatigue card is added to the discard.
- At the start of each turn, Stamina is restored.
- In the game there will be some items that will restore or increase Stamina

Fatigue (card) - Cannot be Exiled. Do nothing.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33480917/22ffa3da328755b52e3847dff92032fc290a7a10.png

Greetings to all and this is the first developers diary. In which we would like to share with our players, what we are working on now and what will appear in the game soon.

BETA
First, in the near future, we plan to open a “beta branch” of our game, where everyone can play on the new hero (Berserk) and try new items and mechanics.
We hope to collect statistics and your feedback, and we hope that it will be interesting for you to take part in it. Although who does not want to try the Berserk and new items;)
New content in Beta will be available in English, Russian and maybe French.

NEW FEATURE
Well, secondly, we are now working on a system under the temporary name - Forecaster
If you briefly describe this system, it will be:
After defeating each of the bosses, you get to Forecaster, which will allow you to:
    Fully restore the health of the character - 1 FP (Fate Points)
    Exile any card from the deck - 1 FP
    Take one of the “Tarot cards” (3 random cards, from which you need to 
choose one). “Tarot cards” work as passive ability - 4 FP
    Increase the maximum HP by 1 - 3 FP
    Delve a Legendary Item - 2 FP
    Delve a Heroic Skill - 4 FP

After defeating the boss you get - 5 FP
All not spent FP burn.

All that has been described above so far, which is in the process of discussion, planning and prototyping. But in any case it will be in the game, in some form.
Since this system allows you to add the functionality that many players are asking for: passive abilities, increasing the maximum HP and the ability to exile cards from your deck.
